data.name: Expeditious Advance
data.description: A Lion Blade's land speed is faster than normal for her race by 10 feet. This benefit applies only when she is wearing no armor or light armor and not carrying a heavy load. Apply this bonus before modifying the Lion Blade's speed because of any load carried or armor worn.
